about.intro: Software, hardware and support for businesses in Lebanon and Qatar — since 2020.
about.story:
Socially Middle East was founded in **2020** with a simple idea: businesses in our region deserve technology that just works — and a team that picks up the phone when it doesn’t.

We started by building software. Along the way our customers kept asking for the same thing: one partner for the whole setup. So we grew into exactly that — **POS systems, ERP, websites and online stores**, plus the **terminals, printers, tablets and servers** they run on.

Today we serve restaurants, hotels, shops and companies in **Lebanon and Qatar**. We design, configure, install and support every system ourselves, so there is never any doubt about who to call.
about.mission: Give every business in the Middle East systems that are simple to use, built around how they really work, and backed by people who care.
